nodes.long_description: Pensa, apaga e resolve o mistério! Delete One Part testa a tua lógica num mundo 3D vibrante. Por que vais adorar: mecânica de apagar intuitiva, lógica humorística, estilo artístico 3D polido e resolução de problemas relaxante, ao teu próprio ritmo.
nodes.short_description: Borracha pronta! Resolve puzzles removendo o que não pertence à cena. Usa os teus comandos como uma borracha mágica para revelar objetos ocultos e descobrir a verdade.

nodes.long_description: Tänk, sudda och lös mysteriet! Delete One Part utmanar din logik i en levande 3D-värld. Varför du kommer älska det: intuitiv sudd-mekanik, humoristisk logik, snygg 3D-grafik och avkopplande problemlösning utan tidspress.
nodes.short_description: Suddgummit är redo! Lös pussel genom att ta bort det som inte hör hemma. Använd dina kontroller som ett magiskt suddgummi för att avslöja dolda föremål och sanningen.

nodes.long_description: Pensez, effacez et résolvez le mystère ! Delete One Part teste votre logique dans un monde 3D vibrant. Pourquoi vous allez l'adorer : mécanique d'effacement intuitive, logique pleine d'humour, style artistique 3D et résolution de problèmes sans stress.
nodes.short_description: Gomme prête ! Résolvez des énigmes en supprimant ce qui n'a pas sa place. Utilisez vos manettes comme une gomme magique pour révéler des objets cachés et découvrir la vérité.

nodes.long_description: Σκεφτείτε, σβήστε και λύστε το μυστήριο! Το Delete One Part δοκιμάζει τη λογική σας σε έναν ζωντανό τρισδιάστατο κόσμο. Χαρακτηριστικά: διαισθητικός μηχανισμός σβησίματος, χιουμοριστική λογική, έντονα 3D γραφικά και χαλαρωτική εμπειρία χωρίς χρονόμετρα.
nodes.short_description: Η γόμα είναι έτοιμη! Λύστε γρίφους αφαιρώντας ό,τι δεν ταιριάζει. Χρησιμοποιήστε τα χειριστήρια ως μαγική γόμα για να αποκαλύψετε κρυμμένα αντικείμενα και την αλήθεια.

nodes.long_description: Думайте, стирайте и решайте логические загадки! В мире Delete One Part всё не то, чем кажется. Почему вам понравится: интуитивная механика стирания, юмористические задачки, яркий 3D-стиль и расслабляющий геймплей без таймеров и стресса.
nodes.short_description: Ластик наготове! Решайте головоломки, удаляя лишнее. Используйте контроллеры как магический ластик, чтобы находить скрытые объекты и раскрывать тайны каждой сцены.

nodes.long_description: Otestujte svou logiku v Delete One Part. V tomto 3D světě věci nejsou takové, jaké se zdají. Proč si hru zamilujete: intuitivní mechanika mazání, vtipná logika, živý 3D styl a relaxační hratelnost bez stresu a časovačů.
nodes.short_description: Guma připravena! Vyřešte hádanky tím, že odstraníte to, co tam nepatří. Použijte ovladače jako magickou gumu a odhalte pravdu za každou scénou.

nodes.long_description: Pensa, cancella e risolvi il mistero! Metti alla prova la tua logica in Delete One Part. Perché ti piacerà: meccanica di cancellazione intuitiva, logica umoristica, stile 3D vivace e risoluzione dei problemi rilassante, senza stress o timer.
nodes.short_description: Gomma alla mano! Risolvi i puzzle eliminando ciò che non c'entra. Usa i tuoi controller come una gomma magica per rivelare oggetti nascosti e scoprire la verità dietro ogni scena.

nodes.long_description: Think, Erase, and Solve the Ultimate VR Logic Mystery! Put your lateral thinking to the test. Armed with a high-tech virtual eraser, examine scenarios and delete the right part to move forward. Features: Intuitive erasing mechanics, humorous logic, vibrant 3D art, and relaxing gameplay. Ready to delete the doubt?
nodes.short_description: Eraser at the ready! Step into Delete One Part: DOP Puzzle, an immersive VR experience where you solve puzzles by removing what doesn't belong.

nodes.long_description: 思考、擦拭並解決終極 VR 邏輯之謎！在 Delete One Part 中考驗您的邏輯。特色：直覺的擦拭機制、幽默有趣的邏輯、鮮豔的 3D 藝術風格，以及無壓力、無計時器的輕鬆解謎體驗。準備好擦掉疑惑了嗎？
nodes.short_description: 擦膠準備就緒！透過刪除不屬於場景的部份來解決謎題。將您的控制器當作魔法擦膠，揭開隱藏物品並發現每個場景背後的真相。

nodes.long_description: 생각하고, 지우고, 수수께끼를 해결하세요! Delete One Part는 3D 세계에서 여러분의 논리력을 시험합니다. 추천 이유: 직관적인 지우기 메커니즘, 유머러스한 로직, 화려한 3D 아트 스타일, 그리고 시간 제한 없는 편안한 퍼즐 해결 경험을 즐겨보세요.
nodes.short_description: 지우개 준비 완료! 어울리지 않는 부분을 지워 퍼즐을 해결하세요. 컨트롤러를 마법 지우개로 사용하여 숨겨진 물건을 찾고 장면 뒤에 숨겨진 진실을 밝혀내세요.

nodes.long_description: Suy nghĩ, xóa và giải quyết bí ẩn logic! Delete One Part thử thách tư duy của bạn trong thế giới 3D sống động. Tại sao bạn sẽ thích: cơ chế xóa trực quan, logic hài hước, phong cách nghệ thuật 3D và trải nghiệm giải đố thư giãn không áp lực.
nodes.short_description: Sẵn sàng xóa bỏ! Giải các câu đố bằng cách loại bỏ những phần không thuộc về cảnh phim. Sử dụng bộ điều khiển như một cục tẩy ma thuật để tiết lộ các vật thể ẩn giấu.

nodes.long_description: Tenk, slett og løs logikkmysteriet! I Delete One Part er ting sjelden slik de ser ut. Hvorfor du vil elske det: intuitiv slettemekanikk, humoristisk logikk, levende 3D-stil og avslappende problemløsning uten tidspress.
nodes.short_description: Viskelæret er klart! Løs gåter ved å fjerne det som ikke hører hjemme. Bruk kontrollerne som et magisk viskelær for å avsløre skjulte gjenstander og sannheten bak hver scene.

nodes.long_description: Düşün, sil ve gizemi çöz! Delete One Part, mantığınızı canlı bir 3D dünyada test eder. Neden seveceksiniz: sezgisel silme mekaniği, mizahi mantık, etkileyici 3D görseller ve zaman sınırı olmayan rahatlatıcı bir deneyim.
nodes.short_description: Silgi hazır! Ait olmayanı silerek bulmacaları çözün. Gizli nesneleri ortaya çıkarmak ve her sahnenin ardındaki gerçeği bulmak için kontrolcülerinizi sihirli bir silgi gibi kullanın.

nodes.long_description: Tænk, slet og løs mysteriet i VR! Delete One Part udfordrer din logik i en levende 3D-verden. Funktioner: intuitiv slettemekanik, humoristisk logik, levende 3D-kunst og afslappende problemløsning i dit eget tempo.
nodes.short_description: Viskelæderet er klar! Løs gåder ved at fjerne det, der ikke hører til. Brug dine controllere som et magisk viskelæder til at afsløre skjulte objekter og sandheden bag hver scene.

nodes.long_description:
Think, Erase, and Solve the Ultimate VR Logic Mystery!

Put your logic and lateral thinking to the test in Delete One Part: DOP Puzzle. In this vibrant 3D world, things are rarely what they seem. Armed with a high-tech virtual eraser, you must examine every scenario, listen to the clues, and delete the right part to move forward. From fixing impossible math to uncovering hidden secrets, every level is a new surprise!

Why You Will Love It:

Intuitive Erasing Mechanics: Use your VR controllers to manually scrub away layers and objects with satisfying, fluid haptic feedback.

Humorous & Tricky Logic: Solve dozens of unique puzzles that challenge your common sense. "Find the mistake," "Wipe away the disguise," and "Solve the mystery!"

Vibrant 3D Art Style: Experience a polished, high-contrast world where characters and objects come to life in full 360-degree immersion.

Brain-Teasing Variety: Every level offers a fresh scenario—from uncovering a secret treasure to helping a character escape a funny situation.

Relaxing & Fun: No timers or stress. Just pure, creative problem-solving at your own pace in a distraction-free virtual environment.

Your brain is the sharpest tool you have, but the eraser is a close second. Are you ready to delete the doubt and solve the puzzle?
nodes.short_description: Eraser at the ready! Step into Delete One Part: DOP Puzzle, a witty and immersive VR experience where you solve puzzles by removing what doesn't belong. Use your controllers as a magical eraser to reveal hidden objects, fix mistakes, and uncover the truth behind every scene. Think outside the box—sometimes the solution is just one swipe away!

nodes.long_description: Denk, wis en los het ultieme VR-logica-mysterie op! In de wereld van Delete One Part is niets wat het lijkt. Waarom je het geweldig zult vinden: intuïtieve wis-mechanica, grappige logica, levendige 3D-stijl en ontspannend puzzelen zonder tijdsdruk.
nodes.short_description: Gumpakker! Los puzzels op door te verwijderen wat er niet thuishoort. Gebruik je controllers als een magische gum om verborgen objecten te onthullen en fouten te herstellen.

nodes.long_description: Denken, löschen und das Logik-Rätsel lösen! In Delete One Part ist nichts, wie es scheint. Warum Sie es lieben werden: intuitive Lösch-Mechanik, humorvolle Logik, lebendiger 3D-Stil und entspanntes Knobeln ohne Zeitdruck.
nodes.short_description: Radiergummi bereit! Lösen Sie Rätsel, indem Sie entfernen, was nicht hingehört. Nutzen Sie Ihre Controller als magischen Radierer, um versteckte Objekte und die Wahrheit zu enthüllen.

nodes.long_description: ¡Piensa, borra y resuelve el misterio! Pon a prueba tu lógica en Delete One Part. Por qué te encantará: mecánica de borrado intuitiva, lógica humorística, estilo artístico 3D vibrante y resolución de problemas relajante sin estrés ni cronómetros.
nodes.short_description: ¡Borrador listo! Resuelve acertijos eliminando lo que no pertenece. Usa tus controles como un borrador mágico para revelar objetos ocultos y descubrir la verdad detrás de cada escena.

nodes.long_description: 考えて、消して、謎を解け！『Delete One Part: DOP Puzzle』は、あなたの論理力と直感を試すVRゲームです。特徴：直感的な消去アクション、ユーモア溢れるロジック、鮮やかな3Dアート、そしてマイペースに楽しめるリラックスしたゲーム性。さあ、あなたの消しゴムで答えを導き出しましょう！
nodes.short_description: 消しゴムの準備はOK？不要なものを見つけて消去し、パズルを解き明かそう！魔法の消しゴムを使って、隠されたオブジェクトや真実を暴き出すVR体験。

nodes.long_description: 思考、擦拭并解决终极 VR 逻辑之谜！在 Delete One Part 中考验您的逻辑。理由：直观的擦拭机制、幽默有趣的逻辑、鲜艳的 3D 艺术风格，以及无压力、无计时的轻松解谜体验。准备好擦掉疑惑并解决难题了吗？
nodes.short_description: 橡皮擦准备就绪！通过删除不属于场景的部分来解决谜题。将您的控制器当作魔法橡皮擦，揭开隐藏物品并发现每个场景背后的真相。

nodes.long_description: 思考、擦拭並解決終極 VR 邏輯之謎！在 Delete One Part 中考驗您的邏輯。特色：直觀的擦拭機制、幽默有趣的邏輯、鮮豔的 3D 藝術風格，以及無壓力、無計時器的輕鬆解謎體驗。準備好擦掉疑惑了嗎？

nodes.long_description: Gândește, șterge și rezolvă misterul! Delete One Part îți testează logica într-o lume 3D vibrantă. De ce îți va plăcea: mecanică de ștergere intuitivă, logică amuzantă, stil artistic 3D și rezolvare de probleme relaxantă, fără cronometre.
nodes.short_description: Radiera e gata! Rezolvă puzzle-uri eliminând ce nu se potrivește. Folosește controllerele ca pe o radieră magică pentru a dezvălui obiecte ascunse și adevărul din spatele fiecărei scene.

nodes.long_description: Ajattele, pyyhi ja ratkaise logiikkapähkinät! Delete One Part haastaa luovan ajattelusi 3D-maailmassa. Miksi rakastat sitä: intuitiivinen pyyhkimismekaniikka, huumoria ja logiikkaa, värikäs 3D-tyyli sekä rentouttava kokemus ilman kiirettä.
nodes.short_description: Pyyhekumi valmiina! Ratkaise arvoituksia poistamalla asioita, jotka eivät kuulu joukkoon. Käytä ohjaimia taikapyyhekumina ja paljasta totuus jokaisen kohtauksen takaa.

Your brain is the sharpest tool you have, but the eraser is a close second. Are you ready to delete the doubt and solve the puzzle?
nodes.short_description: Eraser at the ready! Step into Delete One Part: DOP Puzzle, a witty and immersive VR experience where you solve puzzles by removing what doesn't belong. Use your controllers as a magical eraser to reveal hidden objects, fix mistakes, and uncover the truth behind every scene. Think outside the box—sometimes the solution is just one swipe away!

nodes.long_description: Denk, wis en los het ultieme VR-logica-mysterie op! In de wereld van Delete One Part is niets wat het lijkt. Waarom je het geweldig zult vinden: intuïtieve wis-mechanica, grappige logica, levendige 3D-stijl en ontspannend puzzelen zonder tijdsdruk.
nodes.short_description: Gumpakker! Los puzzels op door te verwijderen wat er niet thuishoort. Gebruik je controllers als een magische gum om verborgen objecten te onthullen en fouten te herstellen.

nodes.long_description: Denken, löschen und das Logik-Rätsel lösen! In Delete One Part ist nichts, wie es scheint. Warum Sie es lieben werden: intuitive Lösch-Mechanik, humorvolle Logik, lebendiger 3D-Stil und entspanntes Knobeln ohne Zeitdruck.
nodes.short_description: Radiergummi bereit! Lösen Sie Rätsel, indem Sie entfernen, was nicht hingehört. Nutzen Sie Ihre Controller als magischen Radierer, um versteckte Objekte und die Wahrheit zu enthüllen.

nodes.long_description: ¡Piensa, borra y resuelve el misterio! Pon a prueba tu lógica en Delete One Part. Por qué te encantará: mecánica de borrado intuitiva, lógica humorística, estilo artístico 3D vibrante y resolución de problemas relajante sin estrés ni cronómetros.
nodes.short_description: ¡Borrador listo! Resuelve acertijos eliminando lo que no pertenece. Usa tus controles como un borrador mágico para revelar objetos ocultos y descubrir la verdad detrás de cada escena.

nodes.long_description: 考えて、消して、謎を解け！『Delete One Part: DOP Puzzle』は、あなたの論理力と直感を試すVRゲームです。特徴：直感的な消去アクション、ユーモア溢れるロジック、鮮やかな3Dアート、そしてマイペースに楽しめるリラックスしたゲーム性。さあ、あなたの消しゴムで答えを導き出しましょう！
nodes.short_description: 消しゴムの準備はOK？不要なものを見つけて消去し、パズルを解き明かそう！魔法の消しゴムを使って、隠されたオブジェクトや真実を暴き出すVR体験。

nodes.long_description: 思考、擦拭并解决终极 VR 逻辑之谜！在 Delete One Part 中考验您的逻辑。理由：直观的擦拭机制、幽默有趣的逻辑、鲜艳的 3D 艺术风格，以及无压力、无计时的轻松解谜体验。准备好擦掉疑惑并解决难题了吗？
nodes.short_description: 橡皮擦准备就绪！通过删除不属于场景的部分来解决谜题。将您的控制器当作魔法橡皮擦，揭开隐藏物品并发现每个场景背后的真相。

nodes.long_description: 思考、擦拭並解決終極 VR 邏輯之謎！在 Delete One Part 中考驗您的邏輯。特色：直觀的擦拭機制、幽默有趣的邏輯、鮮豔的 3D 藝術風格，以及無壓力、無計時器的輕鬆解謎體驗。準備好擦掉疑惑了嗎？
nodes.short_description: 橡皮擦準備就緒！透過刪除不屬於場景的部分來解決謎題。將您的控制器當作魔法橡皮擦，揭開隱藏物品並發現每個場景背後的真相。

nodes.long_description: ¡Piensa, borra y resuelve el misterio! Pon a prueba tu lógica en Delete One Part. Por qué te encantará: mecánica de borrado intuitiva, lógica humorística, estilo artístico 3D vibrante y resolución de problemas relajante sin estrés ni cronómetros.
nodes.short_description: ¡Borrador listo! Resuelve acertijos eliminando lo que no pertenece. Usa tus controles como un borrador mágico para revelar objetos ocultos y descubrir la verdad detrás de cada escena.

nodes.long_description: Pense, apague e resolva o mistério! Delete One Part testa sua lógica em um mundo 3D vibrante. Por que você vai amar: mecânica de apagar intuitiva, lógica humorística, estilo artístico 3D polido e resolução de problemas relaxante, no seu próprio ritmo.
nodes.short_description: Borracha pronta! Resolva quebra-cabeças removendo o que não pertence à cena. Use seus controles como uma borracha mágica para revelar objetos ocultos e descobrir a verdade.

nodes.long_description: Gândește, șterge și rezolvă misterul! Delete One Part îți testează logica într-o lume 3D vibrantă. De ce îți va plăcea: mecanică de ștergere intuitivă, logică amuzantă, stil artistic 3D și rezolvare de probleme relaxantă, fără cronometre.
nodes.short_description: Radiera e gata! Rezolvă puzzle-uri eliminând ce nu se potrivește. Folosește controllerele ca pe o radieră magică pentru a dezvălui obiecte ascunse și adevărul din spatele fiecărei scene.

nodes.long_description: Ajattele, pyyhi ja ratkaise logiikkapähkinät! Delete One Part haastaa luovan ajattelusi 3D-maailmassa. Miksi rakastat sitä: intuitiivinen pyyhkimismekaniikka, huumoria ja logiikkaa, värikäs 3D-tyyli sekä rentouttava kokemus ilman kiirettä.
nodes.short_description: Pyyhekumi valmiina! Ratkaise arvoituksia poistamalla asioita, jotka eivät kuulu joukkoon. Käytä ohjaimia taikapyyhekumina ja paljasta totuus jokaisen kohtauksen takaa.
